title: fix(core,objectql): effective object permissions read the external write gate, so a read-only external object is no longer offered New, Import, Edit or Delete
body:
domain:server#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CXSTW6WZn81ULyBVdb

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgT9jn2ZF9jPKnKcCY79qSph)_
Fixes #30370

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：对外部只读对象（数据源 external 且未双重开写），服务端给控制台和 `current_user.can()` 的有效权限不再含新建、编辑、删除、转移，可用操作里也去掉了 create/update/delete/upsert/bulk/import。
- 为什么改：这类对象的写入早就被引擎一律拒绝（403 EXTERNAL_WRITE_FORBIDDEN），但权限答复仍说可写，管理员看到新建/导入/编辑/删除按钮，填完表单才被拒。
- 风险与回滚：只收紧本来就写不进去的对象的答复，托管数据源对象字节不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.ts`（新夹紧步骤与 apiOperations 过滤）、`packages/objectql/src/engine-registration.ts`（写闸判定抽成一处，谓词与拒绝共用）、`packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/current-user-endpoints.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run src/security/effective-object-permissions.test.ts`，预期 49 条全过，其中 6 条 [#30370]。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Root cause.** `buildEffectiveObjectPermissions` (`@objectstack/core`) folds permission sets, super-user wildcards, the managed-write guards and API exposure into the map that `/auth/me/permissions` serves and `current_user.can()` reads, and its stated purpose is to reflect what the server actually enforces. It never read ADR-0015 §5.3 Gate 3, the external write gate objectql applies to every insert, update and delete (`assertWriteAllowed`: a federated datasource, and not both `datasource.external.allowWrites` and `object.external.writable`). So on a read-only external object the map granted writes the data plane refuses `403 EXTERNAL_WRITE_FORBIDDEN`, and the console's `resolveAffordance` offered New, Import, Edit and Delete.

- **`@objectstack/objectql`** — `ObjectQL.isExternalWriteForbidden(objectName)`: the gate's verdict as a read-only question. The gate is now judged once, in `externalWriteGateClosure` (`engine-registration.ts`); `assertWriteAllowed` throws on that same closure (message unchanged), and the predicate answers whether it is non-null. The `engine.ts` member is a one-call delegation stub (`check:facade-delegation-only` green).
- **`@objectstack/core`** — a new optional `isExternalWriteForbidden` accessor on `EffectiveObjectPermissionsSchemaSource`, and `engineExternalWriteForbidden(engine)` (asks the engine's member when present; an engine without it forbids nothing, the `registryObjectPackageDisabled` shape from #28877). In `buildEffectiveObjectPermissions`, after the managed-write clamp: the verdict is judged for every entry before anything changes (a throwing predicate is reported once and clamps nothing), then `clampExternalReadOnlyWrites` sets `allowCreate` / `allowEdit` / `allowDelete` / `allowTransfer` to `false` and lowers `modifyAllRecords` to the `viewAllRecords` read it implies (otherwise the spec's `objectPermissionGrants` would still answer edit / delete / transfer `true` on it). `annotateEffectiveApiOperations` takes the same verdicts as an optional third argument and drops the write operations (`create`, `update`, `delete`, `upsert`, `bulk`, `import`, `restore`, `purge`) from what such an object is served, always annotating it. Read and export are untouched.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-security`** (`getEffectiveObjectPermissions`) and **`@objectstack/plugin-hono-server`** (`/auth/me/permissions`) both hand over `engineExternalWriteForbidden(ql)`, so the two consumers stay byte-equal.
- No `ui/**` change: the console already reads `apiOperations` and `can()`.

**Expected side effect.** Server-side `current_user.can(object, 'create' | 'edit' | 'delete' | 'transfer')` now answers `false` on a read-only external object, matching what the write itself always met.

## Tests

- `packages/core/src/security/effective-object-permissions.test.ts` — new `[#30370]` describe (6 cases): explicit grant, plain wildcard and super-user wildcard all lose every write verb and keep read and export; `modifyAllRecords` lowered to the read; a narrowed `apiMethods` object is served its narrowed reads only; an open gate or no accessor leaves the map byte-identical; a throwing predicate clamps nothing and warns once; `engineExternalWriteForbidden` asks the engine's own member.
- `packages/objectql/src/external-write-gate.test.ts` — new `[#30370]` describe: over the double opt-in matrix (neither, datasource only, object only, `validate-only`, both, managed) the predicate's verdict equals what insert, update and delete each meet (`code` `EXTERNAL_WRITE_FORBIDDEN`, `status` 403, or no refusal); default-datasource and unknown objects are not forbidden.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/current-user-endpoints-effective-objects.test.ts` — the served `objects` slot for a read-only external object has no write grant and no write operation, byte-equal to `buildEffectiveObjectPermissions` with the engine's predicate; reopening the gate restores them.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/get-effective-object-permissions.test.ts` — the member's map is byte-equal to the endpoint computation, and `current_user.can('deal', 'create' | 'edit' | 'delete' | 'transfer')` evaluates `false`.

## Acceptance notes

- Scope as the seat's claim widened it (6654819469): objectql predicate plus its `engine.ts` stub, the core step, the two map builders, their tests, one changeset. One file beyond the list: `packages/core/src/security/index.ts`, the barrel line that exports `engineExternalWriteForbidden` beside `registryObjectPackageDisabled` (the two plugins import it from `@objectstack/core`). No `ui/**` or `packages/spec/**` change.
- Declarations measured from the diff: `Clause-②: yes (widening)` (new public `ObjectQL.isExternalWriteForbidden`, new export `engineExternalWriteForbidden`, new optional accessor and optional third argument on `annotateEffectiveApiOperations`; a caller passing none gets the old map), `Metadata-protocol: none` (nothing an author can write changes). `patch` changesets for the four published packages.
- The `#30334` item 2 refusal line (ui thread) is untouched; with this change the console should no longer reach that refusal from New / Import / Edit / Delete on such an object.
- Noted, not filed (read-only inference, no public-door reproduction): the same `objectPermissionGrants` reading means `clampManagedObjectWrites` can leave edit / delete / transfer `true` on a guarded managed object when a permission set names that object explicitly with `modifyAllRecords: true` (the clamp clears the `allow*` bits only). This PR lowers `modifyAllRecords` for the external gate only and leaves the managed clamp as it was. Dedupe words: `clampManagedObjectWrites modifyAllRecords`, `managed write clamp super-user explicit entry`, `objectPermissionGrants modifyAll guarded`.
- Serial note: #30053 slice 2 also edits `engine.ts` docblocks; the stub added here is a new public member below the private `assertWriteAllowed` stub and edits no existing docblock. Whichever lands second merges `main`.
